rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something happens immediately or without delay.

example.english: Call me promptly if anything happens.
example.jyutping: jau5 me1 si6 zau6 zik1 hak1 daa2 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something happens very soon or quickly, rather than specifically immediately.

example.english: Don’t worry, the bus will arrive promptly.
example.traditional: 你放心，班車好快就到喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 fong3 sam1 baan1 ce1 hou2 faai3 zau6 dou3 laa3
